name: Tailored Wool Blend Blazer
description: Crafted from a refined Italian wool blend, this single-breasted blazer features structured shoulders, notched lapels, and a contemporary relaxed silhouette designed for effortless day-to-evening tailoring.

name: Merino Ribbed Crewneck
description: Spun from 100% extrafine Merino wool, offering sublime warmth with zero bulk. Accented by subtle ribbed cuff detailing and a relaxed drop-shoulder cut.

name: Japanese Selvedge Denim
description: Woven on vintage shuttle looms in Okayama using 13.5oz ring-spun cotton. Cut with a modern straight leg and finished with classic copper hardware.

name: Modern Trench Coat
description: A weather-resistant gabardine double-breasted trench featuring a storm flap, belted cuffs, and a fluid silhouette tailored to drape elegantly over knitwear.

name: Silk Camp Collar Shirt
description: Sand-washed mulberry silk shirt offering a liquid drape and a laid-back Cuban collar. Features mother-of-pearl buttons and a vented hem.

name: Pleated Wide-Leg Trousers
description: Tailored with a high-rise waist and fluid double front pleats. Woven in a durable tropical wool blend that resists wrinkling throughout the day.

name: Heavyweight Boxy Tee
description: Constructed from 280 GSM organic combed cotton with reinforced collar ribbing and a drop-shoulder boxy fit engineered for everyday luxury.

name: Italian Leather Chelsea Boots
description: Handcrafted in Tuscany from vegetable-tanned calfskin leather. Fitted with flexible elastic side gussets and a durable Vibram rubber-injected sole.

name: Cotton Canvas Chore Jacket
description: Inspired by authentic French workwear. Features three patch pockets, contrast corozo buttons, and a sturdy 12oz duck canvas shell.

name: Cashmere Knit Scarf
description: Pure Mongolian cashmere brushed to delicate softness with delicate fringed ends. Generously sized to wrap comfortably in frosty climates.

name: A-Line Poplin Midi Dress
description: Crafted from crisp organic cotton poplin. Featuring a fitted bodice with square neckline, discreet side seam pockets, and a sweeping tiered skirt.

name: Minimalist Leather Tote
description: Full-grain pebbled leather tote bag with reinforced dual top handles, magnetic snap closure, and an interior zippered compartment for a 14-inch laptop.
